glossary.definition: (B) "Residential care facility" has the same meaning as in section 3721.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:
As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Neglect" means recklessly failing to provide a resident with any treatment, care, goods, or service necessary to maintain the health or safety of the resident when the failure results in serious physical harm to the resident. "Neglect" does not include allowing a resident, at the resident's option, to receive only treatment by spiritual means through prayer in accordance with the tenets of a recognized religious denomination.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Exploitation" means taking advantage of a resident, regardless of whether the action was for personal gain, whether the resident knew of the action, or whether the resident was harmed.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Misappropriation" means depriving, defrauding, or otherwise obtaining the real or personal property of a resident by any means prohibited by the Revised Code, including violations of Chapter 2911. or 2913. of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Resident" includes a resident, patient, former resident or patient, or deceased resident or patient of a long-term care facility or a residential care facility.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:
As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (I) "Psychological abuse" means knowingly or recklessly causing psychological harm to a resident, whether verbally or by action.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (J) "Sexual abuse" means sexual conduct or sexual contact with a resident, as those terms are defined in section 2907.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (K) "Physical restraint" has the same meaning as in section 3721.10 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (L) "Chemical restraint" has the same meaning as in section 3721.10 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (M) "Nursing and nursing-related services" means the personal care services and other services not constituting skilled nursing care that are specified in rules the director of health shall adopt in accordance with Chapter 119. of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (N) "Personal care services" has the same meaning as in section 3721.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (O)(1) Except as provided in division (O)(2) of this section, "nurse aide" means an individual who provides nursing and nursing-related services to residents in a long-term care facility, either as a member of the staff of the facility for monetary compensation or as a volunteer without monetary compensation.

glossary.definition: (Q) "Religious nonmedical health care institution" means an institution that meets or exceeds the conditions to receive payment under the medicare program established under Title XVIII of the "Social Security Act" for inpatient hospital services or post-hospital extended care services furnished to an individual in a religious nonmedical health care institution, as defined in section 1861(ss)(1) of the "Social Security Act," 79 Stat. 286 (1965), 42 U.S.C. 1395x(ss)(1), as amended.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (R) "Competency evaluation program" means a program through which the competency of a nurse aide to provide nursing and nursing-related services is evaluated.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.21 to 3721.34 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
(S) "Training and competency evaluation program" means a program of nurse aide training and evaluation of competency to provide nursing and nursing-related services.
